comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.body: This page arrives in a later phase of the NARRATIV web app.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: An unexpected error occurred. Try again, or reload the page.

offline: You are offline. What you see may be out of date.

errors.network: Cannot reach NARRATIV. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

username.pattern: Only letters, numbers, dots (.) and underscores (_)

password.tooLong: The password is too long, use fewer characters

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to keep up with the stories of people you follow.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Share your stories and follow the people you care about.
register.agreement: By creating an account you agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
register.success: Your account is ready. Welcome to NARRATIV!

otp.title: Check your email
otp.sentTo: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It expires in {{minutes}} minutes.
otp.resendIn: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s
otp.resent: A new code is on its way.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email linked to your account and we will send you a code.
forgot.success: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.

feed.homeEmptyBody: Follow people to see their stories here, or look around in Explore.

post.title: Post
post.takenDown: This post was taken down by a moderator.
post.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or you cannot see it.

delete.title: Delete this post?
delete.body: It disappears from every feed and its comments go with it. This cannot be undone.

profile.notFoundBody: This account does not exist, or you cannot see it.

search.label: Search people
search.hint: Type a username to find people to follow.

problem.type: Only JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF photos and MP4, MOV, WebM videos can be posted.
problem.imageSize: Photos can be up to 5 MB.
problem.videoSize: Videos can be up to 50 MB.
problem.tooMany: A post has at most {{max}} photos and videos.

comments.title: Comments
comments.deleteWithReplies: Its replies are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
comments.takenDown: This comment was taken down by a moderator.
comments.empty: No comments yet. Be the first.
